# FunkYouSHiFT

Official site: https://www.funkyoushift.com/
Preferred canonical domain: https://www.funkyoushift.com/
Current version: v3.3.0

FunkYouSHiFT is a Borderlands creator and Discord community hub. The site routes visitors to Discord, Borderlands modding help, modded weapons and gear pages, trading, builds, streams, videos, giveaways, merch, and useful resources.

Important pages:
- https://www.funkyoushift.com/ — homepage and main routing hub
- https://www.funkyoushift.com/borderlands-discord.html — Borderlands Discord server page for BL3/BL4, trading, modded gear, builds, and help
- https://www.funkyoushift.com/discord.html — direct community conversion page
- https://www.funkyoushift.com/borderlands-modded-weapons.html — modded weapons and modded gear help page
- https://www.funkyoushift.com/borderlands-modding.html — primary Borderlands modding authority guide for BL3/BL4, modded weapons, tools, safe resources, and Discord help
- https://www.funkyoushift.com/borderlands-trading.html — Borderlands trading, loot, and gear help
- https://www.funkyoushift.com/borderlands-builds.html — Borderlands builds and build help
- https://www.funkyoushift.com/borderlands-build-videos.html — curated build video resources
- https://www.funkyoushift.com/borderlands-resources.html — Lootlemon, MentalMars, BL4Hunt, videos, and resource links
- https://www.funkyoushift.com/video.html — streams, clips, and watch content
- https://www.funkyoushift.com/merch.html — FunkYouSHiFT merch through Streamlabs
- https://www.funkyoushift.com/giveaway.html — giveaway information

Primary topics:
Borderlands Discord, Borderlands 3 Discord, Borderlands 4 Discord, Borderlands trading Discord, Borderlands modding, Borderlands modded weapons, modded gear, Borderlands builds, giveaways, streams, Twitch, YouTube, Lootlemon, MentalMars, BL4Hunt.

- v3.2.1: Gallery slideshow uses a generated manifest and auto-removes missing image cards to avoid broken gallery tiles.

- v3.3.0: Locked in Borderlands modding authority page, strengthened homepage modding signals, updated Discord/modded weapon snippets, schema, sitemap, and internal routing for modding search intent.


## v3.3.1 Internal Link Priority

## v3.3.2 resource expansion
- Added BL-SDK mod databases for Oak2, Oak, Willow2, and Willow1.
- Added BL4 Editor, Save Editor, Fling BL3 Trainer, and Fling BL4 Trainer resource links with third-party tool warnings.
- Added GenieBot tutorial and GenieBot/GZO Discord link as third-party community resources.
- Added Maxroll Borderlands 4 planner and creator links for Moxsy, Ki11er Six, Joltzdude139, and LazyData.


## v3.3.3 Creator Integration Patch
- Converted YouTube creator videos to click-to-load embeds so YouTube does not load on initial page load.
- Converted Maxroll BL4 planner to click-to-load iframe attempt with direct fallback.
- Expanded creator SEO/resource mentions for Moxsy, Ki11er Six, Joltzdude139, LazyData, Dantics, and RestAssured.
- Kept third-party creator/resource language clear: links are references, not FunkYouSHiFT-owned content.
